originalTitle: Teen rocker Nene Royal becomes first Thai to win America's Got Talent
summary: Her heavy metal performance trumped nine other finalists, including magicians and even a robot crew.
content:
Nene emerged as a clear fan favourite early in the competition

Nene Royal, a 16-year-old rocker, has been crowned the latest winner of America's Got Talent - making her the first ever Thai winner of the long-running talent show.

For the show's finals on Tuesday in California, Nene, whose real name is Rattikarn Amloy, performed a rendition of Seven Nation Army by American rock duo The White Stripes.

Her heavy metal performances trumped nine other finalists, including magician acts, canine performers and even a robot dance crew.

Many in Thailand are celebrating her win, with some saying they were proud that she had made it to "one of the biggest stages in the world". The Thai government has called her an "inspiration to anyone who dares to dream big".

Nene emerged as a clear fan favourite early in the competition, after a viral clip of her audition, in which she belted out Zombie by The Cranberries to a stunned panel of judges. The video has racked up 20 million views.

On Wednesday night, ahead of the results being announced, Nene took the stage with Linkin Park to perform The Emptiness Machine, a 2024 rock song by the American band.

Later that night she broke down in tears, kneeling on the ground as she was crowned the winner of the show's 21st season - which comes with a prize of $1m (£755,000).

"I'm very happy and emotional right now," she said, thanking everyone for supporting her.

The results show was also eagerly followed by her legion of fans in Thailand, who were unable to watch the live broadcast on the television network NBC.

Many in Thailand had to resort to a YouTube livestream instead - and were thrown into distress when the livestream was abruptly cut in the middle of the results announcements.

But moments later came sighs of relief and exclamations of joy, as word got around that Nene had secured her historic victory.

"History made!" one Thai social media user wrote on Facebook.

"Let the world write it down that this Thai kid is incredibly talented," wrote another.

Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul congratulated Nene Royal, saying in a statement that she had "brought honour to Thailand" and "instilled pride in the Thai people" with her win.

"What makes this win special is that Nene carried her Thai identity with confidence onto one of the world's biggest stages," the Thai government's public relations department said in another statement on Thursday.

"She showed that talent, hard work, and determination can come from anywhere, including a young girl from Phuket with a guitar and a big dream."

Nene Royal, 16, went viral for her heavy metal performances

According to Nene, she started playing the guitar when she was seven years old and harboured dreams of becoming a touring musician.

In her hometown of Phuket, a tourist hub known for its beaches and seaside resorts, Nene was known to busk at Naka Weekend Market.

Piyarat Na Songkhla, 43, tour guide in Phuket, tells the BBC that he has seen Nene Royal perform since she was young.

"She's so adorable," he says. "I feel so elated and happy for her. It's unbelievable that she has gone this far. So proud of her."

The Facebook account of Naka Weekend Market posted a tribute to Nene after her victory.

"Everyone at Naka Market is so proud to see you shine on one of the biggest stages in the world," its post reads.

"Your talent, heart, and courage have inspired so many people, and this victory is a beautiful reminder of what can happen when someone truly gives everything to their dream."

Kajonkiet International School in Phuket, where Nene studies, also congratulated her on the win.

"We are so proud of you," reads a Facebook post from the school, which posted a video of its students and staff gathering to watch Nene's final performance, screaming and chanting her name.
chineseTitle: 青少年摇滚歌手 Nene Royal 成为第一位赢得美国达人秀冠军的泰国人
chineseSummary: 她的重金属表演击败了其他九名决赛选手，其中包括魔术师甚至机器人团队。
chineseContent:
内内在比赛初期就明显成为球迷的最爱

16 岁的摇滚歌手 Nene Royal 荣获最新一届美国达人秀冠军，这使她成为这项长期举办的选秀节目中第一位泰国冠军。

周二在加利福尼亚州举行的节目决赛中，Nene（真名 Rattikarn Amloy）表演了美国摇滚二人组 The White Stripes 的《七国军》。

她的重金属表演击败了其他九名决赛选手，包括魔术师表演、犬类表演甚至机器人舞队。

泰国的许多人都在庆祝她的胜利，有些人说他们为她登上“世界上最大的舞台之一”而感到自豪。泰国政府称她为“任何敢于梦想的人的灵感”。

内内在比赛初期就明显成为了粉丝们的最爱，她的试镜片段在网上疯传，她在视频中向惊愕的评审团高唱了小红莓乐队的《Zombie》。该视频的观看次数已达 2000 万次。

周三晚上，在结果公布之前，Nene 与 Linkin Park 一起登台表演了美国乐队 2024 年的摇滚歌曲《The Emptiness Machine》。

那天晚上晚些时候，当她被加冕为该剧第 21 季的获胜者时，她泪流满面，跪在地上，奖金为 100 万美元（755,000 英镑）。

“我现在非常高兴和激动，”她说，感谢大家对她的支持。

结果显示也受到了她在泰国的大批粉丝的热切关注，他们无法观看 NBC 电视网络的直播。

许多泰国人不得不转而使用 YouTube 直播，但当直播在结果公布期间突然中断时，他们陷入了困境。

但不久之后，随着内内获得历史性胜利的消息传开，人们如释重负地叹了口气，欢呼雀跃。

“历史创造了！”一位泰国社交媒体用户在 Facebook 上写道。

另一位网友写道：“让世界铭记这个泰国孩子非常有才华。”

泰国总理阿努丁·占维拉古 (Anutin Charnvirakul) 向内内·罗亚尔 (Nene Royal) 表示祝贺，并在一份声明中表示，她的胜利“为泰国带来了荣誉”，并“为泰国人民注入了自豪感”。

泰国政府公共关系部门在周四的另一份声明中表示：“这场胜利的特别之处在于，内内充满信心地将她的泰国身份带到了世界上最大的舞台之一。”

“她表明，天赋、努力和决心可以来自任何地方，包括一个来自普吉岛、拥有一把吉他和一个远大梦想的年轻女孩。”

16 岁的 Nene Royal 因其重金属表演而走红

据 Nene 说，她七岁时开始弹吉他，并梦想成为一名巡演音乐家。

在她的家乡普吉岛，普吉岛是一个以其海滩和海滨度假胜地而闻名的旅游中心，Nene 因在纳卡周末市场表演而闻名。

43 岁的普吉岛导游 Piyarat Na Songkhla 告诉 BBC，他从小就看过 Nene Royal 的表演。

“她太可爱了，”他说。 “我为她感到非常高兴和高兴。令人难以置信的是她已经走了这么远。为她感到骄傲。”

Naka Weekend Market 的 Facebook 账户在 Nene 获胜后向她致敬。

帖子中写道：“纳卡市场的每个人都非常自豪地看到你在世界上最大的舞台之一上大放异彩。”

“你的才华、心灵和勇气激励了很多人，这场胜利很好地提醒我们，当一个人真正为自己的梦想付出一切时，会发生什么。”

Nene 就读的普吉岛 Kajonkiet 国际学校也祝贺她获胜。

“我们为你感到骄傲，”学校的 Facebook 帖子写道，该帖子还发布了一段视频，视频中学生和教职员工聚集在一起观看 Nene 的最后表演，尖叫着高呼她的名字。
